P2.2 direct browser build of id Software LinuxDOOM 1.10
=======================================================

Engine baseline: id Software DOOM, pinned commit
a77dfb96cb91780ca334d0d4cfd86957558007e0

Toolchain: Emscripten 6.0.5 + SDL2 + SDL2_mixer.
Music: pinned Vanilla/DMX-compatible Chocolate Doom OPL subsystem.

Public launcher modes:
- PLAY CLASSIC DOOM: original shareware campaign, one local player.
- PLAY AI DEATHMATCH: generated P2.2 E1M1 arena, one human plus three
  real LinuxDOOM player slots controlled by Easy / Normal / Hard bots.

The bundled p22-demo.wad is generated deterministically by
mcp/build_p22_demo_wad.mjs and rebuilt with the pinned ZDBSP pipeline.

P2.2 local multiplayer is intentionally single-process and netgame=false.
Remote browser synchronization remains P3.0 work.
